clusters.title: App Crashes After Completing Level 12
quotes: Game crashes every time I complete level 12. Lost all my progress. Completely unplayable.
Everything works great UNTIL level 12. Then boom, force close every time.
Same crash on level 12 everyone else reports. Disappointing from an otherwise great game.

ticket.title: [BUG] App force-closes immediately after completing Level 12
ticket.description: The game crashes every time a player finishes Level 12, discarding all session progress. Multiple reinstalls don't fix it. This is a P0 regression blocking ~19% of the player base from progressing and directly driving 1-star reviews.
acceptance_criteria: Level 12 completion transitions to the Level 13 intro screen without crash on Android 11+ and iOS 16+
Player XP, coins, and stars earned on Level 12 are persisted across the transition
Crashlytics crash-free rate for Level 12 completion ≥ 99.5% over 7-day post-deploy window
Fix verified against the top 5 device models listed in the crash report

clusters.title: 30-Minute Energy Refill Timer Breaks Session Flow
quotes: 5 lives and then a 30-minute wait? This isn't 2015. The energy system ruins an otherwise fun game.
5 hearts that recharge at 1 per 30 min = 2.5 hours for a full refill. Absolutely not.
1 life every 30 minutes means I need 2.5 hours to refill from zero. This game doesn't respect my time.

ticket.title: [BALANCE] Reduce energy refill timer from 30 min to 10 min per life
ticket.description: The 30-minute wait per life — 2.5 hours for a full refill — is the single most-cited churn driver across the reviews. Players consistently report quitting the session and switching to a competitor app. Industry benchmark is 10 minutes per life.
acceptance_criteria: Life refill timer reduced to 10 minutes
Previously purchased energy bundles are unaffected by the balance change
Timer countdown is visible and accurate in the HUD
D1 and D7 retention tracked against control cohort; no regression vs baseline

clusters.title: $9.99 Starter Pack Perceived as Poor Value
quotes: The starter pack is a ripoff. 500 gems for $10 won't even get you past one hard level.
$9.99 for a 'starter pack' that runs out in a day? Hard pass.
Starter pack is overpriced at $10. Would buy at $2.99.

ticket.title: [MONETIZATION] Reprice Starter Pack from $9.99 to $2.99 and audit gem quantity
ticket.description: Players consistently call the $9.99 starter pack a 'ripoff'. Multiple reviews state they would purchase at $2.99–$3.99. The current pricing converts poorly and generates negative reviews instead of revenue. The persistent session-start popup is an additional irritant.
acceptance_criteria: Starter Pack offered at $2.99 in A/B test for 30% of new installs (first 7 days)
Gem quantity rebalanced so perceived value is maintained at the new price point
Persistent session-start popup replaced with a one-time offer shown 48h post-install
7-day IAP conversion rate and revenue-per-install tracked vs control group

clusters.title: Unskippable Interstitial Ad After Every Level
quotes: An ad after EVERY level. That's not monetization, that's harassment.
I counted: 8 unskippable ads in a 20-minute session. Uninstalled.
30-second unskippable ads after every level. The game is literally 50% ads by time.

ticket.title: [MONETIZATION] Reduce interstitial ad frequency from every level to every 4 levels
ticket.description: A 30-second unskippable ad after every single level is the top uninstall trigger mentioned in reviews. Players describe it as 'harassment'. Reducing to every 4 levels maintains ad revenue while restoring session flow. Surface an ad-free subscription option after the second ad seen.
acceptance_criteria: Interstitial ad fires at most once every 4 completed levels
No interstitial within the first 3 levels of any session (onboarding/re-engagement protection)
Ad-free subscription option surfaced prominently after the user's second ad in a session
Session length, ad impressions/session, and D1 retention tracked post-deploy

clusters.title: Players Requesting Guild System and PvP Mode
quotes: Please add a guild system! I want to play with my friends.
Would be a 10/10 game with guild wars. The puzzle engine is perfect for PvP.
Requesting: friends list, guild, weekly tournaments. This game deserves social features.

ticket.title: [FEATURE] Add Guild system with async weekly PvP challenge
ticket.description: Guild and competitive play are the most-requested social features. Reviewers indicate they would increase spend and recruit friends if social features existed. The match-3 format is well-suited to async score-based PvP.
acceptance_criteria: Players can create or join a guild (up to 30 members) via invite code or name search
Guild roster screen shows member levels and weekly contribution scores
Weekly Guild Challenge: each member's score on a designated level is summed for a leaderboard
Top-3 guilds at week end receive a cosmetic reward distributed to all members

clusters.title: Core Gameplay and Visuals Earn Strong Praise
quotes: Absolutely love this game. The graphics are stunning and the puzzles are perfectly balanced.
Best match-3 game I've played in years. Incredibly addictive and visually gorgeous.
Candy Kingdoms is my go-to stress relief. The level design is creative and satisfying.

ticket.title: [INSIGHT] Core loop and visuals are the retention foundation — protect this cohort
ticket.description: 5-star reviewers consistently praise the puzzle balance, animations, and visual design. This cohort is the highest-LTV segment. Prioritise features that extend their engagement; validate any core mechanic changes against this group first.
acceptance_criteria: 5-star reviewer cohort identified and tagged in analytics dashboard
D30 and D60 retention tracked separately for this cohort
Survey deployed to 5-star cohort before next roadmap cycle to gather feature preferences
Any proposed change to core match-3 mechanics requires A/B sign-off from this cohort
